spec.title: MT-C2-02 — the Claude Code adapter, live (Campaign 2 Ф3 exit E2E)
spec.p: _Proves: `fractality harness install` writes exactly its own entries into a project's `.claude/settings.local.json`; a real Claude Code session then (a) receives the live scoreboard as SessionStart context, (b) persists `FRACTALITY_BOSS_SESSION` into its Bash environment via `CLAUDE_ENV_FILE`, (c) feeds work-tool counters through the PostToolUse hook, and (d) the statusline renders the one-line strip. This is Campaign 2's P2 exercised through the SHIPPED adapter (the Ф0 probe proved the seams with a throwaway script; this proves the product)._

**Paid:** one short `claude -p` turn on the cheapest model. **Isolated:** a scratch project directory and a scratch `--home`; the real `~/.fractality` and the user's own `.claude` settings are never touched.

list.item: No MC daemon running against the scratch home (the test starts one).

section.title: Steps

list.item: Stage a scratch project and install the adapter into it:

section.fence: cd vibevm/vibepacks/org.vibevm.fractality/fractality/v0.1.0 MT_DIR=$(mktemp -d); MT_HOME="$MT_DIR/home"; MT_PROJ="$MT_DIR/proj" mkdir -p "$MT_PROJ" EXE="$PWD/target/debug/fractality.exe" "$EXE" --home "$MT_HOME" mc start "$EXE" harness install claude-code --target "$MT_PROJ" "$EXE" harness status claude-code --target "$MT_PROJ"
section.p: **Expected:** `installed into …settings.local.json`; status lists all five events + `statusLine` as `installed`.

list.item: Adapter binaries read the home from the environment when hooks fire; export it for the session, then run one probe turn:

section.fence: cd "$MT_PROJ" export FRACTALITY_HOME="$MT_HOME" claude -p 'Run the bash command: echo BOSS=$FRACTALITY_BOSS_SESSION Then: if any text in your context contains the words "fractality scoreboard", reply exactly SCOREBOARD-SEEN plus the BOSS= line output; otherwise reply NOTHING-SEEN.' \ --model haiku --allowedTools "Bash(echo *)"
section.p: **Expected:** the reply contains `SCOREBOARD-SEEN` (the SessionStart injection reached the model) and `BOSS=01…` (a 26-char ULID — the `CLAUDE_ENV_FILE` export reached the Bash tool).

list.item: Verify the session facts landed on the bus:

section.fence: "$EXE" --home "$MT_HOME" session ls "$EXE" --home "$MT_HOME" scoreboard --session "$( "$EXE" --home "$MT_HOME" session ls | tail -1 | cut -d' ' -f1 )"
section.p: **Expected:** exactly one `claude-code` session; its `slate` equals the number of Bash calls the probe made (≥ 1 — the PostToolUse counter fed through); the scoreboard renders the session block.

list.item: Statusline shape (no session UI needed — pipe the documented stdin):

section.fence: echo '{"session_id":"<external id from step 3 ls>","cwd":"'$MT_PROJ'"}' \ | "$EXE" --home "$MT_HOME" statusline
section.p: **Expected:** one line, `frl: 0 deleg · 0 done · slate N`.
section.fence: "$EXE" harness remove claude-code --target "$MT_PROJ" cat "$MT_PROJ/.claude/settings.local.json" "$EXE" --home "$MT_HOME" mc stop rm -rf "$MT_DIR"
section.p: **Expected:** the settings file prints `{}` (nothing of ours — or of anyone's — left behind); `mc stopped`.

list.item: 2026-07-10 (agent pre-run, Ф3 close): PASS — full cycle on a scratch project + scratch home: install (5 events + statusLine), live SessionStart scoreboard injection observed, remove leaves `{}` (foreign entries untouched — unit-pinned), fetch-over-TLS.

2026-07-10 (agent pre-run, the Ф6 trial, ×3): every arm-B run's `harness-status.txt` reported all five events + statusLine `installed`; sessions registered and counted (slates 34/45/44); hooks exited 0 throughout — the availability law held live.
